questions.question: What did Moses ask God to show him?
How did the LORD speak with Moses at the tent of meeting?
options: Face to face, as one speaks to a friend
Only through visions in the night
Through Aaron, who relayed all of his words
In thunder, as on the mountaintop
questions.answer: Face to face, as one speaks to a friend
